# Install

## macOS
1. brew tap acme/tools
2. brew install acme-cli
3. acme --version

## Linux
1. curl -fsSL https://get.example.test/acme.sh -o acme.sh
2. sh acme.sh
3. acme --version

INSTALL.md.equals:
# Install

## macOS
1. brew tap acme/tools
2. brew install acme-cli
3. acme --version

## Linux
1. wget https://get.example.test/acme.tar.gz
2. tar xzf acme.tar.gz -C /usr/local/bin
3. acme --version
